description: A recorded multi-turn tool-using session, shaped like the TwoFit marketing agent (specs/twofit-agent.md): one web_search tool whose arguments must be schema-shaped JSON, streamed, with conversation history growing across turns.
why_recorded: Replay is deterministic on purpose. The assistant and tool messages appended to history are the RECORDED ones, never what the model just produced, so the prompt prefix is byte-identical on every run. A benchmark that fed the model's live output back in would measure a different conversation each time, which makes prompt-cache behaviour and latency percentiles incomparable between runs.
system: You are a marketing research agent. Use the web_search tool for anything time-sensitive. When you have results, answer with a JSON object containing the keys summary, points, and sources. Be concise.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web for current information and return ranked results.

turns.user: What is the latest on embedded finance for small merchants? Search first.

replay_tool.content: [{"title":"Embedded finance adoption among SMB merchants","url":"https://example.invalid/embedded-finance/1","content":"Small and mid-sized merchants increasingly obtain working capital, card issuing and payout rails directly inside the software they already use for scheduling and invoicing. turns.user: Now give me the three most important points as JSON.

replay_assistant.content: {"summary": "Embedded finance for SMB merchants is consolidating around platforms that already hold settlement data.", "points": ["Underwriting from observed cash flow beats filed statements", "Take rates are compressing; speed and reconciliation differentiate", "Payout speed outranks headline pricing for merchants"], "sources": ["https://example.invalid/embedded-finance/1", "https://example.invalid/embedded-finance/2"]}

turns.user: Search again for how card issuing pricing has changed, then update the summary.
